operations.what: each row's queries over a span first .. last of its cached positions, every query seeing the whole span (no causal mask), scaled by the head width's inverse square root
operations.verify: on the target against the FP64 reference: within 8e-3 absolute plus 2e-2 relative (BF16 probabilities times BF16 values, FP32 sums, one rounding of the output)
operations.invariance: a row's bits independent of the rows beside it and of the row count
